evals.prompt: Check whether our German site https://example.de loads anything before cookie consent, and whether the Impressum and Datenschutzerklärung are complete.
evals.expected_output: Should load pages in a fresh context without interacting with the banner, record third-party requests, cookies and storage, then compare with reject and accept. Should check the banner for an equal reject option, no pre-ticked boxes, and easy withdrawal. Should check the Impressum against § 5 DDG and the privacy policy against Art. 13 DSGVO and the observed third parties. Should phrase findings as risks, not legal verdicts, and use LEG- IDs with a third-party table.
assertions: Records requests and cookies before any consent interaction
Checks reject option on the first layer
Cross-checks privacy policy against observed third parties
Recommends legal review for high-risk items
